lens: Geometry and proportion first at the matched q15 (row 34 D-G head-on as y_47300; scale render/photo 1.11 from the 0.43 m back, 147 vs 132 px at seat D; 1.05 from seat pitch), then materials, colour, lighting and artefacts. issues.title: Headrest cover ~1.3x too tall head-on (carried four rounds)
issues.evidence: prof.py q15: 72-73 x 83 px (H/W 0.87-0.88) vs y_47300 49-50 x 65-73 px (0.67-0.75); at the 1.11 back-width scale 65 vs 49 px tall, 75 vs 69 px wide. The cover is the most repeated dark shape in q15, so its proportion shows on every seat. Note the conflict in questions_econ 21: y_47306 head-on reads ~0.88.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: shorten from the bottom ~3 cm, raising the headrest cushion with it so no pad edge shows under the flap. Cover plate loft: first SECs 0.595 / 0.625 -> 0.625 / 0.645, width 0.245-0.248 -> 0.238; hem band SECs 0.597 / 0.616 -> 0.627 / 0.646, gTube y 0.597 -> 0.627, stitch 0.6165 / 0.6177 -> 0.6465 / 0.6477, mark 0.6185 / 0.6225 -> 0.6485 / 0.6525, and cz base (y - 0.575) -> (y - 0.605). Cushion and wing lofts: first SECs 0.605 / 0.61 / 0.62 / 0.625 -> +0.025. Far LOD box l.360 height -0.03, centre +0.015. Targets q15: cover 54-58 px tall, 72-77 px wide, H/W 0.72-0.78.
